a: Story points estimate relative effort/complexity, not exact hours.
Team estimation technique using cards to converge on story points.
Estimates are wide early and narrow as knowledge grows.
Add contingency for unknowns; do not pretend precision you lack.
Split large work into vertical slices you can demo.
Identify risky unknowns and spike them before committing dates.
Velocity is completed points per sprint; use trends, not single sprints.
Missed integration, testing, polish, and meetings cause underestimates.
Give ranges and assumptions; update when facts change.
Adding people late to a late project can make it later.
